prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: preview-only personal portfolio world-map concept. PROJECTS castle exhibition redesign, NORMAL state.
Edit target: supplied four-island world illustration.
Primary request: replace ONLY the PROJECTS island's horizontal flat gallery architecture with a majestic DESIGN EXHIBITION CASTLE. The owner exhibits their four real design projects here. It should read immediately as a grand inhabited castle that also visibly contains galleries. Keep the original beautiful daylight palette and painterly matte material. This is a candidate image, not production UI.
KEEP INVARIANT: image dimensions and camera; ABOUT tree studio island at upper left, SKILLS workshop/waterwheel island at lower left, CONTACT lighthouse island at lower right; their exact shapes, scale, placement, lighting, and all four existing labels; the surrounding blue sky and clouds. Only edit within the existing large PROJECTS island's upper-right footprint, from its roofline through its rock base if needed. No changes to the other three islands. No new islands, characters, extra labels or browser UI.
PROJECTS NEW DESIGN:
- One substantial castle mass with an impressive broad central vaulted Great Exhibition Hall, flanked by TWO asymmetrical towers: one square taller keep and one shorter rounded turret. Desaturated sage slate roofs, warm pale limestone, deep teal-grey shaded recesses and selected timber details. Towers visually rise above the main hall with clearly different roof heights. Entire architecture fits within the image with sky above each roof; nothing cropped.
- Central hall has an enormous tall stone entrance arch and a wide terraced stair. Recess the wooden double doors slightly; doors closed in this normal state. Small windows, parapets and low railings establish human scale without excessive tiny details. Restrained ivy on a few edges, grouped small trees.
- Exactly FOUR large clearly distinguishable exhibition display surfaces are integrated into OPEN FRONT GALLERIES: two bays to the left and two to the right of the main entrance. Two panels portrait format for app work, two landscape for web work. Place them at the fronts of the galleries where their full rectangular display surfaces are visible, not behind solid walls. These are clean matte ivory exhibition boards with slim physical wood frames and functional ceiling-mounted exhibit lamps. Panels intentionally BLANK for later compositing of the owner's genuine project images. No fabricated screenshots, logos, paintings, illegible text or icons. Keep them substantial and readable at map size, occupying enough facade to signal a portfolio exhibition, but they are physically integrated, not giant billboards or hovering holograms.
- Sculpt a broad stable stone terrace supported on the two original split cliff masses. Keep a large dramatic open-air chasm BELOW the castle and the main waterfall dropping through it. The castle feels much taller and more monumental than the previous single-storey gallery. Adjust ONLY Projects terrace height/rock proportions as necessary to give the towers room without enlarging or moving this island into other islands. Keep Projects the clearly dominant landmark.
- Architecture should have convincing load paths, stairs actually reach its entrance, gallery display boards fit inside real bays. A beautiful coherent three-quarter silhouette, not a pile of repeated towers, tiny arches or disconnected fragments.
Lighting/style: match the existing image's warm sunlight from upper left, broad painterly color planes, matte limestone, soft natural vegetation, turquoise water. Normal state naturally illuminated, restrained warm interior lamp points, no active sweeping spotlights yet. Preserve overall brightness. No glossy plastic, excessive gold, neon/cyan portals, glowing outlines, gold filigree, dense decorative noise, flags, heraldic game symbols, copied franchise castles or branding.
Existing text remains exactly: ABOUT, SKILLS, PROJECTS, CONTACT in their current positions and style.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: preview-only world-map illustration for a personal portfolio, distinct tree species and seasonal microclimates.
Edit target: supplied four-island CASTLE version of the world-map. This is an image candidate, NOT website implementation.
Primary request: give the four destination islands clearly different vegetation species, colors, and seasonal feelings while retaining the same coherent bright painterly fantasy world. The user likes the original blue sky, warm limestone and natural green palette. Change vegetation deliberately rather than applying color filters to entire islands.
Preserve: exact canvas size/aspect ratio, overall camera and all four island positions, building designs, rock shapes, waterfalls, labels ABOUT / SKILLS / PROJECTS / CONTACT and their placement. Preserve the Projects exhibition castle with central double door, two asymmetrical towers, four blank cream exhibition panels, broad stair, and great chasm waterfall. Keep the About studio, Skills workshop/waterwheel and Contact lighthouse unchanged.
Fix one existing framing issue: the uppermost tip of the left Projects tower is clipped by the canvas edge. Shorten/reposition ONLY its upper tower/roof enough to show its complete tip with a visible sliver of blue sky above. Also keep the right turret roof tip fully inside the image. Do not zoom out, crop other islands or shift their placement.
Seasonal planting:
ABOUT / SPRING at upper left: retain the impressive organic spreading main tree silhouette, but make it an old flowering cherry tree with soft pale blush blossoms mixed with fresh yellow-green leaves; individual large pink-and-green canopy clusters, not a solid cotton-candy pink ball. Young green undergrowth and a few understated tiny white flowers around the studio deck. Warm welcoming personal place, sparse drifting petal implied by 2–3 petals only. Main tree remains a tree with credible branches.
SKILLS / SUMMER at lower left: robust deep summer-green broadleaf oak and plane trees with broad lobed canopy masses, ferns and low lush grass. Richer forest green but naturally sunlit and matte; no pink flowers, no autumn leaves, no overgrown vines hiding the workshop, wheel or benches. The functional workshop and water channel remain readable.
PROJECTS / AUTUMN at upper right: fewer but distinctive elegant golden-yellow ginkgo trees and a couple of restrained burnt-orange Japanese maple accents on castle terraces and outer edges. Mix some surviving sage-green planting so the scene stays related to the original palette. Trees kept small relative to the grand castle, set behind/beside architectural masses, never blocking its four exhibition panels, entrance or towers. A few grouped fallen ochre leaves near the stairs, no dense ground debris. Do not turn the castle, water, sky or rocks orange. Autumn color belongs to foliage only.
CONTACT / EARLY WINTER at lower right: sparse wind-shaped blue-green pines/junipers, a small bare-branched tree near the low harbor building, cool sage grasses, a light dusting of pale frost on a FEW shaded shrub tops and ground patches. Keep exposed warm limestone and open turquoise harbor water. No heavy snow, ice sheets, frozen waterfall, blizzard, grey sky or nighttime. Strong, airy pine silhouettes and the lighthouse still stand out.
Common art direction: consistent upper-left warm midday sun, coherent cool shadows, clear blue sky and white clouds, matte painted limestone and wood, large deliberate foliage shapes and selected detail rather than noisy leaves. This is one coherent world with four local seasonal gardens, not four unrelated climates composited with seams. Preserve normal-state lighting, no active selection dimming, no glow, neon, particles, extra text, arrows, characters or game logos.
The four blank panels remain blank for actual portfolio work to be inserted later. No invented project screenshots.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: supplied four-season, four-island portfolio world-map concept.
Make one extremely narrow composition correction: the tips of the TWO PROJECTS castle towers at the top edge are touching/cut off by the image boundary. Shorten the two tower structures locally, keeping their roof designs and recognizable asymmetry, so that BOTH complete roof tips and ornaments end at least 60 image pixels BELOW the top edge, leaving clear blue sky above them. The shorter roofs should still rise above the castle side galleries. Lower/shorten just the tower upper sections, not the entire island. This is not a zoom or crop.
Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE as closely as possible: exact canvas dimensions, all island positions and sizes, the huge central castle entrance and stairs, four blank exhibition panels, split rock chasm and waterfall, pink spring cherry About island, lush green summer Skills workshop island, gold/orange ginkgo/maple autumn Projects planting, winter pine/frost Contact lighthouse island, bright common blue sky, the four text labels and their exact positions, and existing matte painterly daylight palette.
Do not make the towers tiny; remove only the excess height necessary for the 60px top clearance. Do not redesign the main castle facade, add objects, text, or fabricated portfolio images. No other changes. Output one clean final NORMAL-state preview image.
